decision: Retain source cap 128 pending an explicit quality/speed test. Average question length is about 44 tokens in shard0 and test; prior all-shard sample averaged 46.86. Dynamic padding and length grouping already avoid a fixed 128-token cost. Cap 64 cuts 230 test questions; cap 96 cuts 27; cap 128 cuts 3. No training or inference change made.
